mapper.select: select * from t_user where phone = #{phone} and is_deleted = 0 limit 1
mapper.delete: update t_user set is_deleted = b'1' where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into t_user (xiaolanshu_id, password, nickname, avatar, birthday, background_img, phone, sex, status, introduction, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) values (#{xiaolanshuId}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{avatar}, #{birthday}, #{backgroundImg}, #{phone}, #{sex}, #{status}, #{introduction}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{isDeleted})
